blocks.prompt: 6 Use a differential equation to find the current price of a good if the deflation rate is 11% per year and its price after ten years is expected to be Rs. 5000.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh deflation (qeematon ka girna) ka sawal hai, lekin ulta: aage ki qeemat di hai aur aaj ki qeemat poochhi hai.
Model: \(\frac{dP}{dt} = -0.11P\), kyunke \(11\% = 0.11\) aur qeemat gir rahi hai.
Diya kya hai? 10 saal baad qeemat \(P(10) = 5000\).
Find kya karna hai? Aaj ki qeemat \(P(0) = P_0\).
Plan: \(P = P_0e^{-0.11t}\) mein \(t = 10\) rakh kar \(P_0\) nikalein.
steps:
Diya gaya: deflation 11% salana, \(P(10) = 5000\) rupay; \(t\) saalon mein.
Maloom karna: aaj ki qeemat \(P(0)\).
Tareeqa: decay model \(\frac{dP}{dt} = -0.11P\) (Example 11 ki tarah).

Differential equation hal karein
\[\int\dfrac{dP}{P} = -0.11\int dt\]
\[P = P_0e^{-0.11t}\]
Kyun: variables alag kar ke integrate kiya aur \(e\) liya. Constant \(t = 0\) wali qeemat hai, is liye usay \(P_0\) ka naam diya; yahi humein maloom karna hai.

\(P(10) = 5000\) lagayein
\[5000 = P_0e^{-0.11(10)}\]
\[5000 = P_0e^{-1.1}\]
\[P_0 = 5000e^{1.1}\]
Kyun: dono taraf \(e^{1.1}\) se multiply kiya, kyunke \(e^{-1.1} \cdot e^{1.1} = e^{0} = 1\).
Dhyan dein: is sawal mein initial value nahi di; is liye pehli condition se constant nahi, balke yahi aakhri jawab nikalta hai.

Tasdeeq
\[15020.83e^{-1.1} \approx 15020.83(0.33287) \approx 5000 \;\checkmark\]
Aaj ki qeemat aage wali qeemat se zyada hai, aur deflation mein aisa hi hona chahiye.
blocks.final_answer: Aaj ki qeemat taqreeban Rs. 15021 hai.
